reviews.text: Amazing service, friendly, and they CARE about the animals

I took my small dog there for an appointment and they treated me as though I had eaten their young. At first I thought it was just the receptionist who is unfriendly, but the entire staff is VILE. They flat out refused to allow me in the exam room with my dog, which is odd - I have 51 years experience with dog-ownership and 40 years experience as a pet services professional and I had never experienced that previously. They also don't like questions. I only needed a price list of other vaccines, and what they charge for titer testing. They refused me the information.

Although I no longer live in No Libs, I went back to taking my dog to Northern Liberties Veterinary Center. It's sad that I live in Fishtown, yet I avoid F.A.H.They are not only far more well-versed in dog care, but also treat me with respect.
Excellent care and lovely people, every one of them;
Took advantage that my cat was a senior with diabetes.  Every appt I was nickel and dimed into ordering extra unnecessary tests. After declining some tests I was treated differently.
Excellent service.

I was visiting from Maryland and unexpectedly came in possession of a street kitten. The staff here was so excellent. They were able to give me a squeeze-in appointment, and they treated little Pawl with such thoroughness and gentleness. Also, the facility is so pretty, smells good, and they have relaxing music in the examination rooms. I so wish I could bring this vet with me to Maryland.

EDITED: I made this review after my first visit where the shade was pulled over my eyes. These people do not care about your pet, or you! I went here for 4 years and will not be recommending again.

The staff is always super friendly during visits, and extremely helpful even to answer questions or talk through concerns over the phone inbetween, especially Jaime. Love how caring Dr Newth is and surprised out of all of her patients she does remember little details discussed at previous appointments!! Pricing is super fair for how much they care here!! Love it here!

Wonderful animal hospital. Dr Cohn and the entire team are so thoughtful and treat your pet as their own.

I'm proud to support a local, woman-owned animal hospital like Fishtown Animal Hospital. There are many private equity-owned vets in the city that prioritize profit and speed over quality of care—I recommend avoiding those offices. You can really feel the (superior!) difference when you go to an animal hospital like Fishtown Animal Hospital. ❤️

Go to Fishtown Animal Hospital, not anywhere else in Fishtown. Because this place is an absolute lifesaver and has the BEST office staff and the most caring doctor in charge of it all. If you're looking for high quality medical care for your pet, this is it. Go.

(Find me any other vet running an animal hospital that's saved this many homeless and sick pets using their own personal funds. I'll wait.)

Go to the Pet Mechanic in Fishtown. Because this place is a bloody nightmare and has the WORST office staff and the most uncaring doctor in charge of it all. If you're looking for high quality medical care for your pet, this isn't it. Run.

I feel like they milked my cats UTI and kidney issues. It has been an ongoing thing for 6 months (went for a routine check since she does get UTIs from time to time). Went to an internal specialist they refered me to and they said since she's not symptomatic to stop throwing medications at her only when she becomes symptomatic and to do checks 3-4 months.
Since they refered me to the internal doc and got records sent over and couldn't do a nurse check for a quick blood pressure bc they did not "prescribe it" but sent me to the internal specialist in the first place.  ALSO wanted to do repeat labs....after the SPECIALIST said every 3-4 months!!! And even the specialist I saw was like "hmm why would they need to retest labs when it was not in the final plans." They milk you for your money.

They prolong things that aren't a current issue. My cat went from no medications to 3 supplemts and HBP meds which is fine I'm all about preventive care. But that's all they should have done after reviewing labs and seeing that she is asymptomatic instead of testing every other month and I obliged because my cat is my kid and I don't want her to die.

Also they thought she had bladder stones put $900 down for a deposit. Then when the day of surgery came, the surgeon said that it is not bladder stones and it's just mineralization of her bladder and then the doctor said oh, that's probably why she's getting UTIs because the bacteria can stick onto the mineralization. They then did an ultrasound x-ray 1000 dollars later so I had to pay an extra 127 for imaging... I find that incompetent from Dr. Newsome.

Also at blue pearl that was the FIRST time any one brought up her high blood pressure even after reviewing the medical notes from fishrown vet (over 6 months of notes).

Moral of the story get pet insurance and def get a second opinion if your getting killed with vet bills. They def love to bill for everything and take advantage of your concern for your pets health.

They did treat my cat very well and the front desk staff really is so positive and kind. That's why they get an extra star.

I've been using Fishtown Animal Hospital since moving to the area last fall, and they've been incredibly kind and thoughtful whenever I've had to bring in my dog Shorty for check ins. When I had to take him to a separate ER they actually called me to ask how he was doing, as well as providing various options and recommendations for his care and specialized needs.

They follow up over email very frequently and are always very helpful and kind. I am really appreciative of their vets, staff and technicians.

This place sucks if u call and say ul be only 2 mins late they keep ur money n expect u to pay another 75 for a reschedule visit...they dont care about u being in traffic or anything and they are still open and my cat could have been seen.  2 mins ago..i dont care if there is a 15 minute window.  If your still open see my cat I paid

My girl was seen at Fishtown animal hospital today, and everyone who interacted with her was very professional and friendly! I would highly recommend this vet, especially since they were able to squeeze her in so last minute!
Most wonder vet I've ever been to, ever. So much positive energy and care in this place. 100% recommend

Don’t go here :(
In short- I am MUCH happier with the care at the Pet Mechanic on frankford Ave.

I used fishtown animal for a few years. The vet techs and front desk staff are nice - but -
the Vets themselves are both fairly condescending and frankly always made me feel unsupported or in the wrong. Any small concern I had they wanted to push me into bloodwork or testing.
(If my German Shepherd ((the breed KNOWN to have sensitive stomachs) had diarrhea they would ALWAYS try to pressure me into Xrays.) vs just letting me buy probiotics from them.
wasted lots of money here over nothing way too many times. I would not suggest this vet office.

They would never EVER give advice over email and always wanted to book for in person. Vs at pet mechanic they are happy to help and do not feel like they are always trying to make money.

I also think the vets are often rude and have very odd bedside manners.
Example. One time my dog had a watery eye and the office was closed. I spent all weekend stressing over it and trying to flush her eye out & got the first office visit I could.
When I finally saw the vet she said
“How would you like if I poured that into your eye all weekend??”
….like, how is that appropriate? I’m trying to do my best?
Just one of many examples. I have lots

Again,
Nice vet techs (especially that tall guy) and nice front desk staff (especially the lady with tattoos), but overall
There are better options
Thank you all so much for taking care of Hobo and for the package after he passed with his paw prints and fur 🥺❤️‍🩹 I can’t thank all the staff enough for everything you have all done for him. …

We moved to Fishtown back in October and started bringing our 3 cats here since it was so close to us. I’m SO glad this is the closest vet. They are so caring, respectful and conscientious. I’ve seen a different vet for most visits and they’ve all been wonderful but the vet tech Amani has always been the one to bring us inside and get us situated. She is so good with all of my cats, even my super anxious cat who HATES the vet. We are so grateful for her. The prices here are so reasonable compared to past vets I’ve been to, they follow up via email to check in after appointments and they send appointment reminders too. They take their time to answer all of my ridiculous questions and really get to know your pets. Bottom line: they care!

Update: We've been coming here for 5 years now and they are still taking such great care of our babies. We just had a really stressful medical issue with our youngest cat and both Dr. Wintergrass and Dr. Cohn were so attentive and caring. They truly went above and beyond. The vet techs have also consistently been so helpful, kind and patient with our many visits. Love FAH!!!
Hardcore animal love.   I thank you so much.

I had one of the best experiences ever at Fishtown Animal Hospital! We came in two days ago, and the clinic was clean, and the front desk staff were so welcoming from the moment we arrived. We were even taken back before our appointment time, which was lovely.
Our vet tech was wonderful. She explained everything she was doing, answered all of our questions, and handled our cat with so much care. Shortly after, Dr. Allison Newth came in, already familiar with my cat's history, and continued to answer every question we had without us needing to repeat anything. She was so kind, knowledgeable, and gentle, my cat immediately relaxed.
Both Dr. Newth and the technician took their time explaining each procedure and made sure I understood every step. After the appointment, I checked my cat's online portal and was impressed. Dr. Newth had added detailed notes and personal recommendations for his care.
As a first-time cat owner, I felt completely at ease and supported throughout the entire visit. My cat also received a microchip, and they explained everything about it, including that they use PetLink, which has a one-time $70 fee and lifetime registration.
Cost: Koe’s appointment was $70, and with two vaccines and the microchip, the total came to $171 (excluding the appointment cost)
I am a first-time cat owner and was so nervous about picking a vet. This place is amazing. I’ll absolutely be coming back for every visit. Highly recommend Fishtown Animal Hospital to any pet owner!
I fully trust them with my animals. Which is a lot for me.

I cannot express how happy I am that I choose to change vets. I have three cats so going to the vet is not easy, but I have already taken two out of three cats and am super satisfied with the experience. My one boy is super easy but nervous and he used to come home and hide because my old vet used to take him away from me, but they let him stay with me until blood work and he came home and was happy!! My other boy can be a little difficult, but it was the fastest vet appointment I have ever had and he didn’t even have to take any medication!! They were very accommodating to his feelings and were super friendly. I cannot recommend them enough. Honestly not dreading taking my third cat here on Wednesday! Pics of the boys for tax❤️

Edit: my last boy who is extremely spicy went yesterday and they treated him so kindly and actually gave him a full check up!! This is the first vet I went to that actually helped! I cannot thank them enough!

absolutely loved the office! clean and warm enviorment! loved the calming music they played in the exam room! kept me and my cat calm during the visit! the staff was so nice and professional! they took great care of him and made sure he felt comfortable the whole time! even when he started to set boundaries they stayed calm and let him have his space when he needed it! highly recommend! if you have a cat this is a great place to bring them!

We’ve had a really good experience here in our two visits. Each vet tech (+ the great front desk folks) are so friendly and great with Loki, while explaining everything in detail to me patiently and concisely. I really appreciate it all! Loki doesn’t mind coming to the vet so far, and that makes me so happy. Thanks guys!

Dr. Wintergrass is so knowledgeable and kind. Our Golden Retriever Bonnie has a heart condition and she has received the best care from this hospital. I love the entire staff. I would highly recommend bringing any pet here for care. ♥️🫶🏻 …

I am new to Fishtown Animal Hospital and came to them because my beloved 18 year old cat was not doing well.   Every single person at this establishment was incredibly kind and absolutely wonderful.  They are compassionate and I'm so grateful for them. I highly recommend them for your animals!

I adopted my sweet cat from their associated rescue Fishtails and had the best experience during the adoption process and have had nothing but phenomenal, empathetic, and knowledgeable care at all of my check ups and other steps along the way. I swear by this rescue, and Dr. Cohn in particular and have encouraged all my pet parent friends to visit them. Fishtown animal hospital makes my feel at ease that my baby is getting the absolute best care possible at all times.

We recently took our dog in and we were told she needed dental and a mass removed. When it came time to get this done the doctor on staff had no idea what mass we were talking about even though our doctor told us to do this. So we were told to do yet another vet visit with the dental person and the person that does surgical with the sole purpose to identify her masses and let us know if any needed biopsy. Okay yet another expensive visit but we thought it was important. First I get there and they both arent' there even though I was told by them they both have to be there. So finally they both are there and a map of all the masses is made and pointed out one that they think should be removed. Fast forward to the day of surgery and dental and the person taking her in asks ME what mass I want removed. I said the doctor should know since we had an entire visit just for this. I was then asked if I was even the owner in a very rude and judgey way. I said yes and I have an idea of which one but I was never told I had to confirm which one since I am not a doctor. They continue to gaslight me saying I should know that even with human surgery you always have to confirm things. Well I know nothing about surgery so how would I have known this? Shouldn't I have been told to be sure to be able to confirm what THEY told me to do. Absolutely ridiculous in my opinion. Lets add on the fact that every time I have sit in the waiting room with my very scared and anxious dog for 20-30 minutes only to be brought into a different room to wait another 20-30 minutes. We took all of our dogs out of this vet. To sum things up I believe their lack of communication is dangerous and would not trust them with our dogs again.
Our dog loves it here and we’ve never had anything but the best care/attention by Dr Cohn, techs, and staff, especially in urgent situations
They are so kind.
Everyone is so friendly and caring here. Dr. Kohn is the best!
We take all of our cats there, the staff are great and they always go the extra mile
Super caring and amazing people. Glad to bring my pup there!
I love this team so much! Dr. Cohn is one of the few vets I trust with my cats. I appreciate how informative and helpful they are around care. I can't recommend them enough!
Absolutely love the staff here.

We had been bringing our senior dog to FAH for almost 7 years and always had a good experience, until recently. We noticed there has been a higher turnover in the FOH staff and they started to schedule us with a new doctor. Towards the end of October 2024 we noticed an increase in urination & excessive drinking with our dog who is about 13-14yo. We brought her in for initial testing with concerns of Cushing’s disease. After doing blood panels & urine tests, the Doctor said we needed to perform an ultrasound. After the results for that were inconclusive, we did several more weeks of bloodwork & analysis. Cut to the end of December we still didn’t have an answer of what could be causing these issues. However, the Doctor kept prescribing more and more blood tests and even prescribed a liver medication because they were basically trying to do process of elimination by that point. By this time we had spent nearly $2K in tests and had no results, but we still trusted the doctors were telling us what they thought was best.

After being told by the doctor over the phone that we needed to perform yet another blood test & urine analysis and a $300 test for Leptospirosis (a disease in which our dog had no signs or symptoms of), only just one week after the one we had just paid for, and literally being told over the phone “if she doesn’t want to pay for it, then don’t bother scheduling”, we decided to get a second opinion from another vet in NJ. We spoke to the new vet the first week of January and after reviewing her old records from FAH she found that their findings for Cushings was actually inconclusive and recommended we do a Cushings test (which did NOT involve any ultrasounds, which is contradictory to what FAH told us, is the only way to find if she had the disease). Just a few days later, Her test results all came back positive for Cushing’s disease & they are starting her on medication to combat her symptoms.

It’s totally disheartening that not only could our dog have been on this medication and limited her suffering for the past few months, but also to be spoken to in such a belittling manor when we have clearly spent so much money on tests & medications that we probably didn’t even need. This practice has turned into a total money grab, and I would not recommend it to any friends or family.

Came here based on a recommendation after a pretty traumatic ER experience. Dr. Wintergrass and the staff are phenomenal! They were able to recommend options for my lil senior guy. Highly highly recommend to anyone who values their fur baby. Pic of Puma for tax 🐈‍⬛ …
Dr. Cohn and Dr. Newth are wonderful, caring doctors. The front-of-house staff is terrific. The techs are knowledgable and caring. We could not ask for a better vet experience.

Absolute worst place I have ever taken my dog.  They act like they care until they don’t follow through with their word.  Took my 14 year Puggle there for bloodwork, $600, had mast cell tumor looked at, bloodwork was taken, lumps and bumps were measured, teeth were examined, need work, tumor needs to be removed… will contact you in 3 days… fast forward to weeks later when I dropped off a urine sample, which was told needed to be refrigerated, never mentioned prior to sample, and had to be taken again.  I asked about bloodwork results, was told we were “on the list” to be called.  WEEKS later, called again. Received a voicemail which stated that her liver enzyme levels were though the roof and she would need more meds ($200) to regulate them and then an ultrasound ($700-$1000) in order to ensure she was ready to have mast cell tumor removed… roughly $2000-$3000.  I sent ANOTHER email asking why this was not addressed sooner if her blood levels were so severe!? Vet promise to call me on Saturday… crickets… Then was pulled into the exam room by the vet tech while picking up meds for liver enzymes, same dude who told me I needed to take another urine sample, who reassured me that they received my email and they take customer satisfaction very seriously, and it didn’t fall on deaf ears, and somebody would reach out.I received another voicemail from vet, called back, and never received a call back.  I’ve never felt so disgusted by lack of empathy, trust, and compassion, especially since I asked for other options, including homeopathic suggestions or financial assistance, again crickets… which leads me to believe it’s just a money making business.  STAY AWAY!!
I like taking my dog here and he seems to like the people there

We take all four of our cats here and they receive great care. The vets and techs do a great job with both making the cats feel at ease, and with coming up with realistic and effective treatment plans.
We wouldn’t dream of taking our kitties anywhere else!

Love this place and how they treat us here! We have a pup who can be anxious but this crew shows her love and understanding every visit. We are very appreciative of Fishtown animal hospital and won’t go anywhere else for care of our pets.
THE best vets we've ever had AND they don't declaw cats! Highly recommend!!
